booking.notice.item1: Please join the meeting room 10 minutes before class starts, and make sure your microphone and camera are working
booking.notice.item2: To cancel or change a booking, please do so at least 24 hours before class starts — after that, the lesson will be counted as completed
booking.notice.item3: You can only book one teacher per time slot; booking again will automatically cancel the earlier booking
booking.notice.item4: If you are more than 15 minutes late, the teacher may mark you as absent and end the lesson
booking.notice.item5: Course materials will be emailed to you after a successful booking — remember to download them ahead of time
booking.notice.item6: If your connection is unstable or you can't get online, please message your teacher as soon as possible

admin.courses.minLeadInfo.line1: During this period before a lesson starts, students can't book or cancel this lesson.
admin.courses.minLeadInfo.line2: For example, if set to 48 hours, once a lesson is less than 48 hours away, students can no longer book it or cancel an existing booking for it. This gives teachers and staff enough time to prepare or arrange a substitute, and prevents last-minute bookings or cancellations.
admin.courses.maxLeadInfo.line1: Students can only book lessons up to this many days from today.
admin.courses.maxLeadInfo.line2: For example, if set to 30 days, students can book at most 30 days ahead from today — dates beyond that won't be selectable. This keeps a teacher's schedule from being booked too far into the future, making it easier for teachers and staff to plan long-term teaching slots.
